Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
Can you play more than one bribes card for one voting action? I do not see why
not as you can play several mods (unless it specifically says you cannot;
bonding and threats for example) for any particular action. I had 3 bribes
cards in my hand last night and I wanted to cycle thru alot of cards that turn
and when I threw them down, I was told that I could not.
Yes, no? Anyone?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: DOUGDWISE
Messages.Body:
Sorrow,
Your minion may only play one of any single action modifier per action.
The exact quote from the V:tES rule book, p.11, is "Important rule: A
minion cannot use two identical action modifier cards to affect the same
action." But it seems to me that if you had another minion they could
play a second Bribes. I could be wrong of course. ;-)=
Doug Dunaway

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On 11 Sep 1996, Sorrow wrote:

> Can you play more than one bribes card for one voting action?

No.

> I do not see why
> not as you can play several mods (unless it specifically says you cannot;
> bonding and threats for example) for any particular action.

While you can play several _different_ action modifiers to the same
action, you are specifically forbidden in the rules from using the _same_
action modifier by the same minion in an action.

> I had 3 bribes
> cards in my hand last night and I wanted to cycle thru alot of cards that turn
> and when I threw them down, I was told that I could not.
> Yes, no? Anyone?

Nope, they were right.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cbo...@apdi.net (Sorrow) writes:
>Can you play more than one bribes card for one voting action? I do not see why

>not as you can play several mods (unless it specifically says you cannot;

>bonding and threats for example) for any particular action. I had 3 bribes

>cards in my hand last night and I wanted to cycle thru alot of cards that turn
>and when I threw them down, I was told that I could not.
>Yes, no? Anyone?

No. Bribes is an action modifier, and you can't play more than one of each
action modifier per minion per action. (And, since you can't play bribes
and then play Mask1K, there is no way to get a new acting minion into the
action, so you're limited to just one Bribe.)

(VtES rulebook, section 7.2.2)
